sentences.zh: 那天有36,000名球迷到场，猛龙队竟然击败了公牛队。

sentences.zh: 赛季末无关紧要的比赛。

sentences.en: And what's so interesting to me about this game isn't who won or how the teams played,
sentences.zh: 对我而言，这场比赛最有趣的地方不在于谁赢了或者球队怎么打的，

sentences.en: but the way they looked.
sentences.zh: 而是他们的外观。

sentences.en: There's the Bulls, who are just classic NBA.
sentences.zh: 看看公牛队，他们就是标准的NBA风格。

sentences.en: They've had the same
sentences.zh: 他们自

sentences.en: logo since 1966.
sentences.zh: 1966年以来就一直使用同一个

sentences.en: They're wearing their red away jerseys that look basically like every Chicago
sentences.zh: 标志。他们穿着红色的客场球衣，看起来基本上和历来的芝加哥

sentences.en: Bulls jersey ever.
sentences.zh: 公牛队球衣一样。

sentences.en: It's red with the word Bulls written across the front in black and white
sentences.zh: 它是红色的，正面用黑白相间的

sentences.en: lettering.
sentences.zh: 字母写着“Bulls”（公牛）字样。

sentences.en: It's simple.
sentences.zh: 很简单。

sentences.en: Classic.
sentences.zh: 很经典。

sentences.en: But then, there's the Toronto Raptors.
sentences.zh: 但接着，是多伦多猛龙队。

sentences.en: The team is wearing their white home uniforms, which have jagged silver and black pinstripes,
sentences.zh: 球队穿着白色的主场球衣，上面有锯齿状的银色和黑色细条纹，

sentences.en: as if they were cut by slashing Raptor claws.
sentences.zh: 就像是被迅猛龙的利爪划破的一样。

sentences.en: And then, across the whole front, there's a giant
sentences.zh: 然后，在整个球衣正面，有一个巨大的

sentences.en: red basketball-playing dinosaur, who himself is wearing sneakers and a uniform, a totally
sentences.zh: 红色打篮球的恐龙，它自己穿着运动鞋和一套球衣，一套完全

sentences.en: different uniform.
sentences.zh: 不同的球衣。

sentences.en: And he's dribbling a basketball.
sentences.zh: 而且它在运篮球。

sentences.en: And that was just their home uniform.
sentences.zh: 而这还只是他们的主场球衣。

sentences.en: The road
sentences.zh: 那一年的客场

sentences.en: jerseys that year were even more fun.
sentences.zh: 球衣更有趣。

sentences.en: They were bright purple.
sentences.zh: 它们是亮紫色的。

sentences.en: All of this, including the Raptors'
sentences.zh: 所有这一切，包括猛龙队的

sentences.en: name, had been inspired by the Velociraptors in the wildly successful movie, Jurassic Park.
sentences.zh: 名字，灵感都来自轰动一时的电影《侏罗纪公园》中的迅猛龙。

sentences.en: But these jerseys got compared to a different, much friendlier 90s dinosaur.
sentences.zh: 但这些球衣被拿来与90年代另一种更友好的恐龙作比较。

sentences.en: That's now known as the Barney design because their road uniform was purple.
sentences.zh: 现在被称为巴尼设计，因为他们的客场球衣是紫色的。

sentences.en: This is Paul Lucas, uniform obsessive and writer of a column at ESPN called UniWatch.
sentences.zh: 这是保罗·卢卡斯，球衣狂热爱好者，也是ESPN专栏《UniWatch》的撰稿人。

sentences.en: It just, it looks so cartoonish and so ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 它就是，看起来太卡通、太荒谬了。

sentences.en: You look at it, and it's like, really?
sentences.zh: 你看着它，就像是，真的吗？

sentences.en: That's a
sentences.zh: 这是一支

sentences.en: professional, like, top-level team?
sentences.zh: 职业的、顶级的球队吗？

sentences.en: The Raptors jersey may have been particularly garish, but it wasn't the only jersey of its kind.
sentences.zh: 猛龙队的球衣或许格外花哨，但它并不是同类球衣中的唯一。

sentences.en: The 90s were this insane decade of NBA uniform design that produced some of the wildest jerseys
sentences.zh: 90年代是NBA球衣设计疯狂的一个十年，诞生了一些篮球场上

sentences.en: that have ever graced a basketball court.
sentences.zh: 有史以来最狂野的球衣。

sentences.en: Loud, wacky designs, the likes of which had never been
sentences.zh: 张扬、古怪的设计，在此之前

sentences.en: seen before and haven't been seen since.
sentences.zh: 从未见过，此后也未曾见过。

sentences.en: Like the Atlanta Hawks' red and black jersey with a fierce
sentences.zh: 就像亚特兰大老鹰队的红黑球衣，正面中央有一只凶猛的

sentences.en: looking hawk swooping in across the entire front of it, holding a basketball in its little talons.
sentences.zh: 老鹰俯冲而下，小爪子里抓着一个篮球。

sentences.en: Or the Milwaukee Bucks' green uniform with a giant picture of a purple stag.
sentences.zh: 或者密尔沃基雄鹿队的绿色球衣，上面印着一只巨大的紫色公鹿图案。

sentences.en: Paul Lucas called this one great.
sentences.zh: 保罗·卢卡斯称赞这个设计很棒。

sentences.en: I mean, great in the sense that it was so awful it was great.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这种“棒”是指它丑到深处自然萌。

sentences.en: They had this, you know, this purple, garish purple and green color pattern.
sentences.zh: 他们有这种，你知道的，这种紫色、花哨的紫色和绿色配色方案。

sentences.en: It just looks ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 看起来太荒谬了。

sentences.en: But it definitely, all these designs, definitely, they pushed and extended the idea of what a
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，所有这些设计，绝对都推动和拓展了篮球球衣

sentences.en: basketball uniform could be or should be.
sentences.zh: 可以是什么或应该是什么的理念。

sentences.en: And many of these designs can be traced back to one man.
sentences.zh: 而其中的许多设计都可以追溯到一个人。

sentences.en: I'm Tom O'Grady.
sentences.zh: 我是汤姆·奥格雷迪。

sentences.en: I joined the NBA in 1990 as the league's first creative director.
sentences.zh: 我于1990年加入NBA，担任联盟首任创意总监。

sentences.en: Tom grew up in Chicago, sketching and resketching the logos of his hometown Chicago Blackhawks
sentences.zh: 汤姆在芝加哥长大，不断地素描、重画他家乡的芝加哥黑鹰队

sentences.en: and other classic pro hockey teaMs. Tom's love for sports and eye-catching art
sentences.zh: 和其他经典职业冰球队的标志。汤姆对体育的热爱和对引人注目的艺术的敏锐眼光

sentences.en: made this new NBA gig a dream job.
sentences.zh: 使得这份新的NBA工作成为了梦想中的工作。

sentences.en: My first day at the NBA was just filled with excitement.
sentences.zh: 我在NBA的第一天充满了兴奋。

sentences.en: I'd always been a big sports fan
sentences.zh: 我一直是个超级体育迷，

sentences.en: and I loved design and I studied graphic design here at Columbia College back in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 我热爱设计，并在芝加哥的哥伦比亚学院学习平面设计。

sentences.en: And so when I walked in the door in June of 1990, I kind of had to pinch myself because
sentences.zh: 所以当我在1990年6月走进大门时，我简直得掐自己一下，因为

sentences.en: I really didn't believe what was happening.
sentences.zh: 我真的不敢相信这一切正在发生。

sentences.en: Before Tom O'Grady joined the league, most NBA jerseys looked something like that classic
sentences.zh: 在汤姆·奥格雷迪加入联盟之前，大多数NBA球衣看起来都有点像那件经典的

sentences.en: Bulls jersey.
sentences.zh: 公牛队球衣。

sentences.en: They had simple two or three color schemes with the team
sentences.zh: 它们采用简单的两到三种配色方案，正面印着球队

sentences.en: names across the front.
sentences.zh: 名称。

sentences.en: There might have been a stripe here or there,
sentences.zh: 这里或那里可能会有一条条纹，

sentences.en: maybe a cool font, but that was about it.
sentences.zh: 也许有一个酷炫的字体，但也就差不多这样了。

sentences.en: And they weren't designed by designers.
sentences.zh: 而且它们不是由设计师设计的。

sentences.en: The process of designing team uniforms was mostly left up to team equipment managers
sentences.zh: 设计球队球衣的过程大多留给了球队的装备经理，

sentences.en: because they were responsible for getting the players outfitted to play the games.
sentences.zh: 因为他们负责为球员配备比赛装备。

sentences.en: Mostly this consisted of the equipment managers flipping through a catalog
sentences.zh: 通常这包括装备经理翻阅目录，

sentences.en: and choosing a design they liked with the right colors.
sentences.zh: 并挑选一个他们喜欢且颜色合适的款式。

sentences.en: It was not a sophisticated business, let's say that.
sentences.zh: 可以说这不是一项高深复杂的业务。

sentences.en: They were happy just to get uniforms on
sentences.zh: 他们只要能把球衣穿到

sentences.en: the players' backs.
sentences.zh: 球员身上就很开心了。

sentences.en: But that was all about to change because in 1988, the Charlotte Hornets introduced a radical
sentences.zh: 但这即将改变，因为在1988年，夏洛特黄蜂队引入了一个激进的

sentences.en: new idea.
sentences.zh: 新理念。

sentences.en: The color teal.
sentences.zh: 蒂芙尼蓝（青绿色）。

sentences.en: In this archival news footage from 1988, Hornets player Kelly Trapuca stands on stage in front
sentences.zh: 在这段1988年的档案新闻画面中，黄蜂队球员凯利·特拉普卡站在舞台上，

sentences.en: of flashing cameras.
sentences.zh: 面对着闪烁的相机。

sentences.en: Then he rips off his teal tearaway warm-ups to reveal the Hornets' new
sentences.zh: 然后他撕下了他那件青绿色的撕拉式热身服，露出了黄蜂队的新

sentences.en: uniforMs. Teal was not a traditional NBA jersey color.
sentences.zh: 球衣。青绿色并不是传统的NBA球衣颜色。

sentences.en: It's not NBA red.
sentences.zh: 它不是NBA红。

sentences.en: It's not NBA blue.
sentences.zh: 它不是NBA蓝。

sentences.en: It's not Celtics green.
sentences.zh: 它不是凯尔特人绿。

sentences.en: It's not Lakers yellow.
sentences.zh: 它不是湖人黄。

sentences.en: Tom O'Grady had nothing to do with the teal Hornets' uniform, but he took it as a sign
sentences.zh: 汤姆·奥格雷迪与青绿色的黄蜂队球衣没有任何关系，但他把它视为一个信号，

sentences.en: that the league was ready for bolder designs.
sentences.zh: 表明联盟已经准备好迎接更大胆的设计。

sentences.en: It was kind of a leap of faith for the league to say, you know, this is not really something
sentences.zh: 对联盟来说，这算是一种信仰之跃，意思是，你知道的，这并不是我们

sentences.en: we've seen before.
sentences.zh: 以前见过的那种东西。

sentences.en: But as an expansion team, we'll probably let you have this one because
sentences.zh: 但作为一支扩张球队，我们大概会允许你们用这个，因为

sentences.en: maybe there's something new we can learn from this.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以从中学到一些新东西。

sentences.en: And it turned out fans loved the teal Hornets' jersey.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，球迷们非常喜欢青绿色的黄蜂队球衣。

sentences.en: It looked fresh and different.
sentences.zh: 它看起来清新而不同。

sentences.en: It was really very popular.
sentences.zh: 确实非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: They soon became known as the men of teal.
sentences.zh: 他们很快被称为“青绿色男儿”。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden,
sentences.zh: 突然之间，

sentences.en: the Charlotte Hornets had gained great recognition before they'd ever played a basketball game.
sentences.zh: 夏洛特黄蜂队在甚至还没打过一场篮球比赛之前就已经名声大噪。

sentences.en: When Tom O'Grady was hired as the NBA's first creative director two years later in 1990,
sentences.zh: 两年后的1990年，当汤姆·奥格雷迪被聘为NBA首任创意总监时，

sentences.en: he wanted to push jersey design even further.
sentences.zh: 他希望将球衣设计推向更远。

sentences.en: Not just the colors, but the designs on the uniforMs.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是颜色，还有球衣上的图案。

sentences.en: Until the early 90s, there had been real limits to how wild you could get with these designs.
sentences.zh: 直到90年代初，这些设计的疯狂程度一直受到切实的限制。

sentences.en: Because all the details, the numbers, the names, and the logos had to be sewn on.
sentences.zh: 因为所有的细节、数字、名字和标志都必须缝上去。

sentences.en: To do any kind
sentences.zh: 要制作任何种类的

sentences.en: of complicated graphics, it would have taken a massive amount of embroidery.
sentences.zh: 复杂图形，都需要大量的刺绣。

sentences.en: And all that thread
sentences.zh: 而所有的那些线

sentences.en: would have added additional weight and made the jersey hotter to wear.
sentences.zh: 会增加额外的重量，并使球衣穿起来更热。

sentences.en: But soon after Tom O'Grady joined the NBA, he would get some new tools to work with.
sentences.zh: 但就在汤姆·奥格雷迪加入NBA不久后，他将获得一些可用的新工具。

sentences.en: Computer programs like Photoshop and Illustrator helped him dream up new logo designs.
sentences.zh: Photoshop和Illustrator等电脑程序帮助他构思出新的标志设计。

sentences.en: And there was a new technique to get those drawings onto a jersey.
sentences.zh: 并且有一种新技术的出现，可以将这些画作印到球衣上。

sentences.en: It was called dye sublimation.
sentences.zh: 它被称为染料升华转印。

sentences.en: Sublimation changed everything.
sentences.zh: 升华转印改变了一切。

sentences.en: Sublimation is a process of printing dye directly into the fabric.
sentences.zh: 升华转印是将染料直接印入面料中的过程。

sentences.en: Now for the first time, you could design something in Photoshop.
sentences.zh: 现在，你破天荒第一次可以在Photoshop中进行设计。

sentences.en: You could make it big and you could
sentences.zh: 你可以把它做大，并且可以

sentences.en: add a bunch of different colors.
sentences.zh: 添加一堆不同的颜色。

sentences.en: Then with sublimation, you could basically print that design
sentences.zh: 然后通过升华转印，你基本上可以直接把设计

sentences.en: straight onto the material without any embroidery or extra weight.
sentences.zh: 印到布料上，而不需要任何刺绣或额外的重量。

sentences.en: So it allowed us to start to take things we would never normally even consider doing on
sentences.zh: 因此，这使我们能够开始尝试那些我们平时甚至绝不会考虑在

sentences.en: a jersey.
sentences.zh: 球衣上做的事情。

sentences.en: And we started doing more outrageous uniforms and stuff because we could.
sentences.zh: 我们开始制作更多离谱的球衣和设计，因为我们做得到。

sentences.en: We can, so we will.
sentences.zh: 我们能做到，所以我们就会去做。

sentences.en: Tom's first big design was for the Phoenix Suns, who were celebrating their 25th year in the league.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的第一个重大设计是为菲尼克斯太阳队制作的，当时他们正在庆祝加入联盟25周年。

sentences.en: They were moving into a new arena and they wanted a new look.
sentences.zh: 他们将搬进一个新球馆，并想要一个新外观。

sentences.en: So Tom met with their team owner,
sentences.zh: 所以汤姆会见了他们的球队老板，

sentences.en: Jerry Colangelo.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞·科朗格洛。

sentences.en: Jerry was great.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞人很好。

sentences.en: He was a fellow Chicagoan.
sentences.zh: 他也是个芝加哥人。

sentences.en: So as soon as you heard my accent, he's like,
sentences.zh: 所以你一听到我的口音，他就说：

sentences.en: I think we're going to get along.
sentences.zh: 我想我们俩会合得来的。

sentences.en: You know, I think us Chicago guys kind of get this.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我觉得我们芝加哥人挺懂这个的。

sentences.en: Here's
sentences.zh: 这就是

sentences.en: what I want to do.
sentences.zh: 我想做的。

sentences.en: I want to have a logo that's going to last for the next 25 years.
sentences.zh: 我想设计一个能用上25年的标志。

sentences.en: I don't want
sentences.zh: 我不想

sentences.en: to have to change it.
sentences.zh: 频繁更换它。

sentences.en: So I want something futuristic, but classic.
sentences.zh: 所以我要找一种既有未来感又经典的设计。

sentences.en: So Tom and his team start in on the Suns redesign.
sentences.zh: 于是，汤姆和他的团队开始着手太阳队的重新设计。

sentences.en: They come up with this big basketball that's also
sentences.zh: 他们设计了一个巨大的篮球，同时

sentences.en: a Sun.
sentences.zh: 它也是一个太阳。

sentences.en: It has these long red to orange gradient sun rays coming off of it.
sentences.zh: 上面有从红色渐变到橙色的长长太阳光芒。

sentences.en: And then they print this
sentences.zh: 然后他们把这个图案

sentences.en: and a bright purple background onto their new jersey.
sentences.zh: 和亮紫色背景印到了他们的新球衣上。

sentences.en: It's not exactly what I would call classic, but it is bold.
sentences.zh: 这谈不上经典，但确实很大胆。

sentences.en: Definitely bold.
sentences.zh: 绝对的大胆。

sentences.en: As luck would have it, the Phoenix Suns made it to the NBA Finals that year.
sentences.zh: 运气不错的是，菲尼克斯太阳队在那年打进了NBA总决赛。

sentences.en: And the whole
